title_short: Who Gives ad · DR06 · Donor Note: David
headline: A paid ad with one job: make a stranger click and give $5. David gives because he sees exactly where the money goes.
story: David has given to Watsi since 2016. He loves the transparency and trusts the lean team.
He can make a direct impact in people's lives.
One ask: join in with David and give today.
do: Hook text “Why I give: the receipts.” on frame 1.
WHO GIVES card from about 0:02, never first.
Big moments for “transparency” and “direct impact”, one at a time.
End card with the down arrow.
dont: No patient B-roll under a donor voice. No pain, poverty or guilt.
No AI headshot. Real photo only if Mackinnon's is on the Slack thread.
Don't re-voice the audio. Light noise clean only.
